blocks.text: 一張白紙 踮在這个彩色世界
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t tiunn pe̍h-tsuá  liam tsāi tsit-ê tshái-sik sè-kài

blocks.text: 變成你佮我
blocks.spelling: piàn-sîng lí kah guá

blocks.text: 一陣有思想的人 踮在這个現實社會
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t tīn ū su-sióng ê lâng  liam tsāi tsit-ê hiān-si̍t siā-huē

blocks.text: 受環境來拖磨
blocks.spelling: siū khuân-kíng lâi thua-buà

blocks.text: 但是阮知影 路愛家己行
blocks.spelling: tān-sī gún tsai-iánn  lōo ài ka-tī kiânn

blocks.text: 無論這條路上敢有人做伴
blocks.spelling: bô-lūn tsit-tiâu lōo siōng kám ū lâng tsuè  puānn

blocks.text: 但是阮知影 夢愛家己拍拚
blocks.spelling: tān-sī gún tsai-iánn  bāng ài ka-tī phah-piànn

blocks.text: 無論這條路上 是坎坷抑是孤單
blocks.spelling: bô-lūn tsit-tiâu lōo siōng  sī khám-khia̍t ia̍h-sī koo-tuann

blocks.text: 人生這齣電影 就算閣較艱苦嘛愛繼續搬
blocks.spelling: lîn-sing tsit tshut tiān-iánn  tio̍h-sǹg koh khah kan-khóo mah ài kè-sio̍k puann

blocks.text: 用咱的跤步 行出屬於咱的路
blocks.spelling: iōng lán ê kha-pōo  kiânn tshut sio̍k-î lán ê lōo

blocks.text: 毋管別人按怎講 按怎看
blocks.spelling: m̄-kuán pa̍t-lâng án-tsuánn kóng  án-tsuánn khuànn

blocks.text: 人生這齣電影 就算閣較艱苦嘛愛繼續搬
blocks.spelling: lîn-sing tsit tshut tiān-iánn  tio̍h-sǹg koh khah kan-khóo mah ài kè-sio̍k puann

blocks.text: 用咱的希望 行出屬於咱的路
blocks.spelling: iōng lán ê hi-bāng  kiânn tshut sio̍k-î lán ê lōo

blocks.text: 堅持咱的夢 活出精彩的性命
